ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback means a lot to us. We are really sorry to hear you are experiencing a gas leak. We are here to help. 

In almost every case of reported leaks, the rubber gasket on the inside of the propane tank nozzle is oval in shape, as opposed to round, is cracked or is otherwise compromised, and therefore results in a leak. The gasket should be perfectly round, with no nicks or cracks.

Regarding the hole in the bottom of the cabinet, that is not used for the propane tank to rest. The propane tank should be hanging on the tank scale on the right wall of the cabinet. 

Our Care team is reaching out to assist you further. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thanks!
